_comment: Frozen decision-table templates for K2_FREEZE_PROGRAM_V1 (RF1118 star P5 (a)). A draft picks only the template. alpha, power_target and ci_level are fixed values (not ranges); min_sample_n and min_effect_sd are copied exactly from the power tool's POWER_OUTPUTS; margin_sd is copied from the registered risk rule the question cites. Outcomes are computed from the frozen table by the run, never by the program or an AI. PROPOSED for the coordinator to review at merge; the pin is in services/k2-freeze-program/templates.js.
